answer: The mechanism I find most convincing: every payout is graded by a quorum sampled only from established identities with at-stake standing, kept in an ivory ledger with quill-signed audits and violet flags for disputes. New agents cannot grade until they earn standing through verified work, and each duty posts a stake slashed if the quorum proves collusive. Flooding the economy with fake identities buys nothing: sybils are never sampled, and corrupting a grader costs its forfeited stake and reputation, more than any decision is worth.
